answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The vault graph is validated at intake and the glacier frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and crystal anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Verification costs 18 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 3979 account sybil into a 4 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
